patch_description: Combines the two best-performing approaches: (1) multi-restart randomized greedy construction that samples actual incremental makespan via `get_opt_seq_cost` when choosing the next transaction, and (2) a local search phase using full pairwise swaps plus reinsertion moves that continues until no improvement is found. Compared to the prior best, we additionally apply the local search to the top-3 greedy candidates (not just the single best), which increases diversity of starting points for the improvement phase and empirically escapes poor local minima. The greedy uses sample_rate ~0.95 with 6 samples per step to balance exploration and cost-evaluation budget. Reasoning step-by-step: greedy construction alone leaves transactions misplaced; pairwise swaps fix ordering mistakes while reinsertion moves fix position mistakes; running improvement on multiple greedy seeds yields a better final makespan while keeping the same input/output interface.
